text: {"status":"complete","sceneId":"cda55804-4527-4792-ba17-c9bf254471e4","title":"詢問停留原因與等待請求","context":{"text":"對話包含詢問對方為何仍在現場、提及接獲來電時正準備離開的說明、請求稍作等待，以及簡短答應。","evidenceCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"]},"translations":[{"cueId":"c1","text":"你怎麼還在這裡？"},{"cueId":"c2","text":"你打來的時候我正準備要走。"},{"cueId":"c3","text":"你能等一下嗎？"},{"cueId":"c4","text":"好的。"}],"utterances":[{"id":"33e9989d-b3db-4644-a2b8-a129ffa04dcf","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":[],"decision":"basic_only","pointIds":[]},{"id":"f86e2fdb-b8c0-474a-bf49-6f85d2fcdd1f","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":[],"decision":"explained","pointIds":["p1"],"chunks":[{"id":"chk1","spans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":2,"end":20}],"meaning":"正準備要離開"},{"id":"chk2","spans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":21,"end":36}],"meaning":"當你打電話來的時候"}]},{"id":"a4cc90bf-da41-49ab-9449-dd7997350aaf","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":[],"decision":"basic_only","pointIds":[]},{"id":"a4f4e3c2-07e5-4502-9059-28787bd0755e","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":[],"decision":"basic_only","pointIds":[]}],"points":[{"id":"p1","utteranceIds":["f86e2fdb-b8c0-474a-bf49-6f85d2fcdd1f"],"category":"grammar","presentation":"core","title":"be about to + 原形動詞","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"contextCueIds":[],"explanation":"「be about to + 原形動詞」表示即將或正打算做某事。此處使用過去式「was about to leave」，表示在過去某一特定時間點（接獲對方來電之際）原本正要進行離開的動作。","sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":2,"end":20}]}],"reusableItems":[{"id":"r1","pointIds":["p1"],"kind":"frame","sourceForms":[{"cueIds":["c2"],"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":2,"end":20}],"text":"was about to leave"}],"pattern":"be about to [verb]","examples":[{"origin":"ai","situation":"一名員工抵達辦公室並為遲到致歉，同事表示自己剛好正打算打電話詢問。","dialogue":[{"text":"Sorry I'm late, my train was delayed.","translation":"抱歉我遲到了，我的火車誤點了。"},{"text":"No problem, I was about to call you.","translation":"沒關係，我剛才正打算打給你。"}],"targetLineIndex":1,"targetText":"was about to call"}]}]}
